core.fantasy: You are a fighter in a one-on-one duel where reading the other player matters as much as fast hands.
pillars: Easy to start, deep to master
core.signature_moment: You read the jump, punish it, and a big special bursts across the screen in a splash of bright paint.
anti_goals: no random outcomes in a duel

signatures.description: Wind-up, contact pause, splash and reaction make every hit easy to read and feel.
Big moves burst out as bright paint and ink splashes on top of physical materials.
A one-button control mode lets newcomers play the same fight as experts.
One gauge powers defence, offence and big moves; running it out leaves you dizzy and open.

audience.age: teens and adults (rated for fighting violence)

period_s.method: Oracle reference study 2026-10-23: public knowledge (dev talks, reviews, store pages), in our own words; not yet measured on capture

verb_count.method: Oracle reference study 2026-10-23: public knowledge (dev talks, reviews, store pages), in our own words; not yet measured on capture

rendering.signature: Physical materials on exaggerated muscular bodies; the style comes from bright paint and ink splashes that burst out of every big hit.
rendering.lesson: Let the hit effects carry the style: a paint-splash language on top of ordinary materials reads as cartoon impact without gore.

art.motion: mocap; In-house mocap actors perform each fighter's moves; capture is fed straight into the RE Engine

body.note: Health and gauges along the top; the fighter turns grey and dizzy when the gauge is gone.

threat.note: Wind-ups and stances on the other fighter show what is coming.

time.note: Round timer in the middle of the top bar.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle reference study 2026-10-23: public knowledge (dev talks, reviews, store pages), in our own words; not yet measured on capture

screen_budget.fade_rule: Bars stay on in a match; callouts and combo counts flash and fade.

information_grammar.note: Health and power bars along the top, a round timer, combo counters and big text callouts. Bodies show stun and fatigue, and a hit's size shows in the hit-stop and the splash.

tricks: In-house mocap actors perform each fighter's moves; capture is fed straight into the RE Engine
Capcom built real-time preview of capture inside the engine, so animators see it on the character at once
Captured motion is then pushed into strong key poses with hit-stop, so every hit reads
animation.lesson: Capture for weight and timing, then exaggerate the key poses and freeze the contact frame.

expression: its fighters, names, costumes and move names

take.setting: Every hit: a clear wind-up, a 3 to 6 frame freeze on contact, a splash and a big reaction.
One button for a special move, so a young child can play the same fight as a grown-up.
Cartoon impact through bright paint splashes and stars, never blood or injury.
